# Trade Licence Solutions

 > Dan Pleaner, founder of Trade Licence Solutions, helps tradies and builders get their first licence in Australia: builder, company, trade and mutual recognition. Prices are from amounts, ex GST and government fees. Dan is not a government body; the state regulator makes the final decision.

## Key facts
- Founder: Daniel (Dan) Pleaner
- Phone: 0412 767 129
- Website: https://tradelicencesolutions.com.au/
- Service area: Australia, all 8 states and territories
- Prices: general builder licence from $2,000; company or partnership from $550; mutual recognition from $550; trade contractor from $495 (ex GST and government fees); $150 consultation credited to the full fee
